scope.connection: one disposable server shared by Web authority and packaged Native

environment.ownership: one owner connector and one disposable copied fixture

web.input: real CDP pointer double-click, text insertion, and Enter on the shipping thread row

synchronization.webToServer: Web renamed the durable thread and the owner projection observed the exact title.
synchronization.serverToNative: Packaged Native attached with a separate pairing credential and rendered the Web-authored title.
synchronization.serverToWebAfterNativeExit: After Native disposed, the owner renamed the same thread again and the already-paired Web UI updated in place.

productLossClosed: Lynxtron can attach to an existing T3 environment instead of always creating an isolated server and state directory.
Web and packaged Native render and mutate the same durable thread through one server event stream.
Disposing the attached Native client does not terminate the externally owned server.
remainingProductWork: The attachment entry point is currently the explicit T3_LYNXTRON_PAIRING_URL launch contract; a user-facing environment picker and persisted pairing lifecycle are not part of this slice.
classification.policy: No state weights, denominator entries, filters, thresholds, or visual residual policy changed.
